neet_phy_u02_t00_3.working: Motion is relative: the passenger's position is fixed in the train frame but changes in the platform frame.

neet_phy_u02_t00_4.working: On a closed path the displacement is zero, but the path length is not zero, so A is false. R is the correct definition of displacement, so R is true.

neet_phy_u02_t00_5.working: I: |displacement| equals path length for motion in one direction without reversal, which can be the negative direction too, so I is incorrect. II: In 1D, path length exceeds |displacement| only if the direction reverses, so II is correct.
